zh-CN.title: 管理工作台，横竖皆宜
items: 空间管理与平台管理适配宽屏、平板和手机竖屏，导航不再挤作一团
权限编辑、成员详情及管理表单优化横屏布局与深色外观

en.title: Administration in every orientation
items: Space and platform administration adapt to desktop, tablet and portrait phone screens with clearer navigation
Permission editors, member details and management forms have improved landscape layouts and dark appearance
